faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) position at IIT Madras is 02-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First class Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees, or a Second class Post Graduate Degree with a PhD.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000/- plus HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to apply online through the official website of IIT Madras by the specified last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing candidates based on their online applications, followed by a test and/or interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) at IIT Madras is a temporary job.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Madras located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Madras is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600036.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Madras offer any age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is available for SC/ST candidates at the discretion of the Institute if sufficient numbers of candidates are not available.
